registered_before: the confirmation run starts; no data of it exists
purpose: stable-selection-v1 step 4: confirm the frozen ML stable configuration on a fresh live run with a fresh campaign before any claim about its live behaviour; the same run is the blind test of burden-reduction-v1 and the data for the with/without-rules comparison (rule-integration-v1 amendment 1)

run.name: pulse-stable-confirm
run.policy: sentinel_pulse/protocol/policy-cusum-b3-h6.json (frozen; SHA-256 in the launch environment and in CONFIG.json)
run.pairs: 21 workloads x 5 scenarios x 5 rates = 525 attack/control pairs, each with a benign launch
run.starts: after every heavy NFS analysis unit of 22/10 is inactive (scripts/launch_when_idle.sh with WAIT_UNITS)

primary_expectations.subset: rates 6, 12, 24 per second (315 pairs, the same composition as earlier runs)
primary_expectations.confirmed_when: all four hold at one of the two latency tiers; the tier reached is reported

reported_without_threshold: normal alert episodes per replica-hour (selection start to capture end, campaign excluded) with workload bootstrap CI
probe-only share of normal RCA cases (Pulse 5.18 definitions)
recall and p95 per scenario and per rate; rates 1 and 3 per second reported separately (G4, slow attacker): no expectation registered for them
Wilson CIs for the rates; cadence gaps per worker
blind_tests_on_this_run: burden-reduction-v1: any proposed choice (per latency tier) is replayed offline from this run's decisions and features; adopted only if it meets its rule 5 here
rule-integration-v1 amendment 1: arms A (ML only) and B1-B3 on the same trials and normal span
capture_requirements: experiment output mode (full decisions and features) so every offline replay is possible
RCA with probe triage labels, follow-up refusal counters and the binary baseline seeded from the two earlier runs' normal periods (rca-baseline-seed-20261022.json, sha256 a93861ad...)
Falco logs copied off the nodes after the run and kept until the rule comparison is written
no heavy NFS or memory job on any node while the run is active; nothing on masters 2/3
not_claimed: separation of attacks from benign launches (G5)
attacks entering through an application exploit (recall is an upper bound for attacks entering through exec)
